objective: Continuously refresh a fixed, evidence-backed VIA cloud inventory without a local runtime dependency.
constraints: Cloud-only scheduled execution; no interactive credential is deployed.
Read-only inventory and sanitized evidence append only.
No deployment, IAM, secret, service-control, schedule-data, or arbitrary-command authority.
Completion of an audit is not production readiness or launch approval.

tasks.title: Refresh fixed VIA cloud inventory evidence
tasks.instructions: Run only the deployed fixed-function cloud audit. Persist a sanitized report, preserve explicit unknowns, and never accept trigger input as an AWS command or URL.
